themes.title: Far-right push for 'national priority' policies
themes.blurb: Right-wing and far-right parties across multiple countries are intensifying demands for policies that prioritize citizens over immigrants, often framing it as a non-negotiable condition for political alliances. This theme reflects a shared rhetorical and policy convergence, with parties like Vox in Spain, Fratelli d'Italia in Italy, and Rassemblement National in France leading the charge.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Insists on 'national priority' as a condition for supporting PP in regional governments, particularly in Andalusia and Castilla-La Mancha.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Meloni's government fast-tracks electoral reforms to secure majority rule, echoing nationalist rhetoric.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Bardella and Le Pen lead polls with anti-immigration platforms, demanding national priority in housing and welfare.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: Kaczyński's party pushes for policies favoring Polish citizens in welfare and housing, aligning with nationalist priorities.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Milei's government adopts deregulation inspired by Vox's national priority policies, targeting bureaucratic reforms.

themes.title: AfD's constitutional crisis and far-right extremism
themes.blurb: Germany's AfD faces growing scrutiny over its alleged unconstitutionality, with legal reports and political figures across Europe debating its potential ban. This theme highlights the transnational concern over far-right extremism and its impact on democratic institutions, resonating in countries like France, Spain, and Italy.

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland
countries.note: Legal reports suggest AfD violates constitutional principles, sparking debates over a potential ban ahead of state elections.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Faces similar scrutiny over extremism, with Le Pen's eligibility for the 2027 election in question.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Criticized for anti-immigration rhetoric and policies, drawing parallels to AfD's extremist stance.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Meloni's government distances itself from extremist rhetoric but faces internal divisions over far-right alliances.

themes.title: Trump-Meloni diplomatic fallout escalates
themes.blurb: The diplomatic rift between former U.S. President Donald Trump and Italian Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni has intensified, with far-right parties in Europe reacting to the fallout. This theme underscores the broader implications of U.S.-Europe relations on transnational right-wing alliances, particularly in Italy, France, and Spain.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Trump's criticism of Meloni and NATO allies escalates tensions, with far-right figures like JD Vance defending his stance.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Meloni distances herself from Trump, facing backlash from far-right factions within her party.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Le Pen and Bardella navigate the fallout, balancing pro-Trump rhetoric with European alliances.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Abascal aligns with Trump's policies, criticizing Meloni's stance and advocating for stronger transatlantic ties.

themes.title: Judicial and corruption scandals in far-right governments
themes.blurb: Corruption scandals and judicial investigations are plaguing far-right governments and parties across multiple countries, including Argentina, Spain, Poland, and Hungary. This theme reflects a shared pattern of legal challenges undermining political legitimacy and public trust.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Manuel Adorni faces allegations of illicit enrichment, with Milei's government accused of shielding him from scrutiny.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Accused of misusing public funds and spreading misinformation, facing legal challenges over its policies.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: Kaczyński and other PiS leaders face corruption allegations, including unpaid debts and misuse of public funds.

countries.name: 🇭🇺 Fidesz / Tisza
countries.note: Orbán's government faces investigations over the 'gold convoy' scandal, with Magyar's administration pushing for accountability.

themes.title: Internal divisions within far-right parties
themes.blurb: Far-right parties in Germany, Italy, Argentina, and Sweden are grappling with internal divisions, often over leadership, policy direction, or alliances. This theme highlights the fragility of these movements despite their growing influence, with factions splintering over ideological and strategic differences.

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland
countries.note: Faces internal strife over leadership and extremist ties, with members defecting or being expelled.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Meloni's leadership is challenged by factions within her party, including Salvini's Lega and Vannacci's Futuro Nazionale.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Milei's government faces internal divisions over corruption scandals and policy direction, with key figures resigning.

countries.name: 🇸🇪 Sverigedemokraterna
countries.note: Internal conflicts over leadership and policy direction, with factions pushing for stricter immigration controls.
